title: Chess
description: Chess for two people and one phone, with pieces that are turned rather than drawn. Lay it flat between you — White at the near edge, Black at the far one — and the board never moves, exactly as at a real board. Every Staunton piece but the knight is a profile swept on a lathe, so the flared base, the waisted shaft and the collar ring are real geometry catching a real key light. Full rules: castling, en passant, underpromotion, stalemate, dead position, the fifty-move clock and repetition. Three boards: walnut, tournament green and slate.
